messages.subject: empty values in part5
parts:
Dear all,
  I used the GGIR to process my GT9X link data. I found that there were some empty values in part five, like "ACC_spt_wake_VIG_mg_pla", "ACC_day_MVPA_bts_10_mg_pla",  "ACC_day_IN_bts_30_mg_pla", "ACC_day_IN_bts_20_30_mg_pla" and so on. Were they equal to zero? Or I should see them as missing values?  I think they might equal zero. Take "ACC_spt_wake_VIG_mg_pla"  for example, it is empty because GGIR didn't detect very vigorous activity during the sleep period. Is that right?



 Best,
Chan chan.

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] empty values in part5
parts:
I think this is because no time was spent in those behavioural classes. You should be able to verify this with the "dur_..." columns.

I designed it to leave the cell empty when there is not time spent in a class, because filling in zero would give the impression that time was spent with zero acceleration.

Best,

Vincent
